name: What We Found There
source:
The journey for Eddie and Chrissy may have taken a tragic turn--but that doesn't mean it has to end there.

Resume their journey towards romance in this Hellcheer visual novel, where living together can be just as thrilling as the romantic pursuit.

But be wary - even though love is the endgame, the journey is still fraught with peril...

Please enjoy this visual novel that I made as a love letter to the Hellcheer community, jam-packed with fun, adoration, love, puzzles...

And just a little bit of mystery....

[From [url=https://toguchindraws.itch.io/what-we-found-there]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Eddie与Chrissy的旅程也许曾走向悲剧——但这并不意味着故事只能在那里结束。

在这部Hellcheer同人视觉小说中，继续他们的浪漫旅程。共同生活，也能像追求爱情时一样令人心跳加速。

但请小心：即使终点是爱情，旅途依然充满危险……

请享受这部献给Hellcheer同好圈的情书般的视觉小说。这里有满满的乐趣、倾慕、爱情与谜题……

还有一点点神秘……

[摘自[url=https://toguchindraws.itch.io/what-we-found-there]Itch.io[/url]]
